Name: Leah Fuller Blush (For Nyapu)
Author: SmingleDee
Description:
Leah's flesh tones are more similar to her vanilla palette, and slightly less yellow overall.
Blush is changed to a full-face blush like her vanilla portrait because I like when her face goes all pink.

This mod won't work if you just put it in your mod folder, it's a direct replacement for existing textures in another mod.
 
Go to (type in file explorer address bar): C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods\Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong(CP) 1.6.9-11491-1-6-9-1730760881\[CP] Nyapu's Portraits(1.6.9)\assets

Take .png files from the mod and replace files in destination.

Short of a major update expanding portrait spritesheets, should be compatible with about any version.
